description.value:
Soviet intelligence uses Smart weapons to track enemies. When they're located, "Pizdets" is typically the last word they'll ever say.

Category: V. Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: Subcompact SMG

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 20 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Efficient Autosear, Silencer, Smart Rebuild, SMG Snub Barrel • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Improved Smart Ammunition. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 2d6 additional damage (4d6) and expends 4 rounds in a burst. When using Autofire with this weapon, it expends 6 rounds instead of 10 [Efficient Autosear]. If this weapon used Autofire in the previous Round of combat, it now has Autofire (SMG 4) and when rolling for Autofire damage, a single damage die resulting in a 6 is sufficient enough to incur a Critical Injury.

Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Subcompact SMG
Pre-installed: Efficient Autosear, Silencer, Smart Rebuild, SMG Snub Barrel (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
